chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Al-Nu'man, from Artata ibn Habeeb, from Abu Maryam Al-Ansari, who said:

I heard Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) saying: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali! Order your womenfolk not to perform Salat without having dressed up well and not to use a necklace which is made of skin'.

key_terms.سَيْراً: A type of necklace or ornament, specifically one made of leather or hide, which was worn around the neck.
key_terms.عُطُلًا: A state of being undressed, loose, or casual; often interpreted as not wearing proper prayer garments or being in a state of neglect regarding modesty.
key_terms.نِسَاءَكَ: Your womenfolk (wives, daughters, female family members).

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions of dress for women performing prayer according to this hadith from Ja'far al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s directive to Imam Ali (AS) regarding the modesty of women during prayer, specifically warning against 'utl' (often interpreted as being in a state of undress or casual attire) and 'sayr' (leather necklaces or ornaments). In Shia exegesis, this serves as a foundational text for the requirement of proper covering (hijab) and the avoidance of distracting adornments that may invalidate the spiritual focus of the prayer.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Al Noman, from Artat Bin Habeeb, from Abu Maryam Al Ansary who said,

‘I heard Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! Order your womenfolk not to perform Salat (Pray) without having dressed up well and not to use a necklace which is made of skin’.
en.sarwar: 57. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Artat ibn Habib from abu Maryam al-Ansariy who has said the following: “

I once heard Ja’far ibn Muhammad, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘O Ali, instruct your women not to perform Salat (prayer) without having dressed well and not to use a necklace which is made of skin.’”
